---
name: Card Disambiguation
description: Collect the user's card choice.
---
:::ordered_block id=main
steps:
- id: reset_selection
  execute_tool: clear_selected_card
  next: card_selection
- id: card_selection
  instructions: |
    Sub-skill for Card Replace or Report Fraud: confirm which card applies,
    then finish this skill so the parent continues.

    A fraud report on one card does not mean the customer wants to replace that
    same card.

    Otherwise load the cards on their account when you have not yet
    (action_fetch_accounts). Match what they said (card name or last four digits)
    to the name on file and set selected_card_label via set_fields to record the
    choice. When one card
    clearly fits, finish this skill in the same turn without asking again. When
    nothing matches, list the cards on the account and ask which one applies.
    Card pick only — do not discuss fraud, lock, wallet, shipping, or replacement
    here.
    Once the card is selected, complete this skill.
  complete_when: session.card_disambiguation.selected_card_id and session.card_disambiguation.selected_card_label
  next: END
- id: END
:::
